precommitted_interpretation_checks: Consolidated revenue rises +101 USD million: Banking +86, Capital Market +18, Corporate and Other -3. This is an accounting mix, not proof of underlying causal drivers.

GAAP net earnings attributable to FIS swing from -470 to +264, a +734 USD million change. The signed equity-method investment line improves from -598 to -23, +575; without acknowledging that unusually large non-operating swing, calling this ordinary core earnings growth is misleading.

Pre-tax earnings before equity rise +236, taxes rise +77, equity-method earnings improve +575; the continuing-operations net change is +734. GAAP net attributable follows the same +734. These calculations are not identical to adjusted non-GAAP net earnings +73 (716 to 789).
The source uses parentheses for negative GAAP earnings/equity-method losses. Preserve the sign and do not convert -470 to +470 or mix adjusted net earnings into GAAP income.
Adjacent-quarter accounting changes do not establish sustainable improvement, valuation or a trade.
